preflightExisting.name: updateMouseAimBody
preflightExisting.text: const ox = aimTarget.x - player.position.x, oz = aimTarget.z - player.position.z;

preflightExisting.name: updateMouseAimBody
preflightExisting.text: aimTarget.x = player.position.x + ox * c + oz * s;

preflightExisting.name: updateMouseAimBody
preflightExisting.text: aimTarget.z = player.position.z - ox * s + oz * c;
